audit: Existing-evidence MIDI132 coverage closure for canonical rigkontrol3-40h.13
scope: Attached RK3 original audio/MIDI2.8.0 plus existing NIHardwareAgent1.7.4 consumer evidence. Audit metadata only; no proprietary bodies, driver implementation, runtime experiment or ABI shim.
matrix_scope: D1-D5,E1-E6,F1-F3 full narrative and selector/required-scope ledger in Beads rigkontrol3-40h.13; this artifact is coverage evidence, not task tracking.
limitations: Exhaustive address coverage is not a full behavioral parity claim.
Portable72/80-byte MIDIEvent codecs are not the original IOKit service.
Current generic Controller physical proof does not prove DIN loopback, arbitrary profiles or proprietary Guitar Rig/NHL2 interaction.
Import trampolines and C++ aliases are not extra RK3 capabilities.
Current custom identity, poll/history transport and queued Send semantics require the Stage2 necessity/contract decision.

public_abi_thunks.reason: Original C-to-C++ interface thunks forward the public driver methods. The ARM C interface table calls the corresponding concrete methods directly; Intel object offsets are not a required external capability.
public_abi_thunks.stop_gate: Current COM/factory tests and installed loading; DIN behavior remains D3/D4 validation, not proven by thunks.

cpp_driver_object_lifetime.reason: Constructor/destructor variants and forwarding aliases manage original C++ driver storage and factory references. Current calloc state, retained timers/worker, explicit Stop and release_ref replace that layout; no Intel C++ ABI compatibility is claimed.
cpp_driver_object_lifetime.stop_gate: Keep object/context lifetime tests; original private layout is not a new feature to recreate.

com_query_refcounts.reason: QueryInterface/AddRef/Release implement current interface2/IUnknown negotiation and COM lifetime. Factory namespace differs intentionally.
com_query_refcounts.stop_gate: Existing COM/factory tests and actual MIDIServer acceptance; no claim of old provider identity.

base_default_methods.reason: Original base-class defaults return success; concrete Caiaq overrides provide Start/Stop/Send/EnableSource. Current table preserves successful no-op FindDevices/Configure/Flush/Monitor and implements the concrete methods directly.
base_default_methods.stop_gate: Do not invent a future timestamp scheduler merely because Flush/Monitor entries exist.

legacy_one_shot_receive.reason: Original one-shot async selector0 and callback/context marshaling become report-history polling, activation epochs and native host timestamps. The public delivery role exists; original selector/buffering/timestamp-point semantics are not identical.
legacy_one_shot_receive.stop_gate: Stage2 contract decision; retain delivery/lifetime/overrun tests and actual DIN test. No automatic legacy shim.

saved_device_and_service_lookup.reason: Original name/MIDIDevice/service lookups become a fixed attached-RK3 native UID and deterministic private identity property. Old labels, saved IDs and serial/multiunit semantics are not preserved implicitly.
saved_device_and_service_lookup.stop_gate: Attached-unit reuse/reconnect acceptance; multiunit or legacy-ID migration only if explicitly required.

per_device_state_allocation.reason: Original per-device allocation/free includes receive ports, parser state and old user-client handle; current single-unit native state and explicit lifecycle leases replace it.
per_device_state_allocation.stop_gate: Retained context/Stop/reconnect tests; do not copy original source-lifetime defects.

device_offline_removal.reason: Original removal marks its saved CoreMIDI device offline and releases per-service state. Current provider discovery publishes both native devices offline and rejects stale generation/lifecycle work.
device_offline_removal.stop_gate: Existing removal/offline mocks; actual Controller reconnect is evidence for that subset, not DIN loopback.

legacy_port_label_preferences.reason: Original com.caiaq vendor/product plist port labels and image path are not loaded. Current names/namespace are native choices; this cosmetic/migration policy is separate from MIDI bytes and required hardware capabilities.
legacy_port_label_preferences.stop_gate: Record scope choice; do not launch a preferences/editor migration project without a user workflow requirement.

provider_discovery_callbacks.reason: Original kernel-provider matching/IOServiceOpen and first-match/termination callbacks become CoreAudio provider discovery on a500ms timer with CFData info and generation checks.
provider_discovery_callbacks.stop_gate: Explicit architecture/required-client decision before claiming drop-in NI compatibility.

factory_entry.reason: Factory accepts the CoreMIDI driver type and returns a native interface. New bundle/factory identity does not reproduce the old binary identity.
factory_entry.stop_gate: Actual native MIDIServer loading and existing factory tests; no hardware side effect from factory proof alone.

concrete_driver_start_stop.reason: Original provider notification/run-loop lifecycle is replaced by current discovery/input timers, bounded output worker, retained contexts and Stop/Start epochs. Stronger cleanup guards are explicit binding choices.
concrete_driver_start_stop.stop_gate: Keep lifecycle/race tests and plan exact current-host acceptance; no original subscription ABI claim.

source_enable_gate.reason: Original EnableSource gates delivery without a USB command. Current gate adds explicit activation snapshots/history barriers/parser reset and per-listener epochs.
source_enable_gate.stop_gate: Activation tests and no phantom events; retain new-policy distinction for exact parity audit.

immediate_eight_byte_output.reason: Original immediate eight-byte packet-spanning output calls sync4; current queue preserves chunk order but Send means accepted for delivery and uses bounded all-or-nothing admission. Worker drops transient failed entries without replay, matching the original kernel ignoring USB send failure while device exists.
immediate_eight_byte_output.stop_gate: DIN physical loopback; retain queue/failure/stale-lease tests; no timestamp scheduling or identical synchronous-return guarantee.

coremidi_input_emit.reason: Complete parsed messages use native MIDIPacketList/MIDIReceived. Actual generic Controller delivery is proven; physical DIN and exact ingress-vs-parse timestamp semantics remain separate.
coremidi_input_emit.stop_gate: Physical DIN with suitable setup and source/thread/lifetime gates.

compiler_terminate_helper.reason: Clang C++ terminate/unwind landing helper is compiler support, not another RK3 method. Native C compilation has no equivalent legacy C++ exception path.
compiler_terminate_helper.stop_gate: No new driver feature or custom exception implementation required.

parser_object_lifetime.reason: Original parser constructor/destructor variants become caller-owned/resettable C parser state. Intel object layout is not exposed or preserved.
parser_object_lifetime.stop_gate: Existing parser/reset/lifecycle vectors; no private C++ ABI promise.

host_timebase_initialization.reason: Original mach_timebase_info conversions are native host-time conversions; new report timestamp is captured at ingress rather than original userspace parsing.
host_timebase_initialization.stop_gate: Timebase/overflow vectors; exact timestamp-point difference remains D4, not hidden by equal units.

midi1_byte_parser.reason: Running status/system-common/realtime/SysEx and compatibility filtering are reconstructed in C using complete-message packet helpers and bounded state, with original off-by-one hazards excluded.
midi1_byte_parser.stop_gate: Existing split-point/original-derived vectors plus physical DIN; no UMP/MIDI2 claim.
